schedules.limit.title: Schedules only run while AWOG is open
schedules.limit.body: There is no background service. Quit the app and nothing fires; the next missed run happens once when you open it again.
schedules.deleteBody: Delete "{name}"? Sessions and tasks it already created are kept.
schedules.openSession.hint: Opens in its own window (the main list only refreshes on restart).
schedules.run.open: See this run's details and log
schedules.run.logPending: Still running — the log appears when it finishes.
schedules.run.noLog: No log for this run (only command jobs have one, and only when the command actually ran).
schedules.job.sessionPrompt: Send a prompt to a new session
schedules.job.workflowTask: Run a workflow as a task
schedules.form.name: Name
schedules.form.promptPh: Review yesterday's commits and summarise what changed.
schedules.form.mode.hint: Nobody is there to answer a permission prompt, so only unattended-safe modes are offered: Execute runs tools without asking, Plan lets the agent read and think but blocks every write and shell command.
schedules.form.needWorkflow: Pick a project and a workflow.
schedules.form.args.hint: One argument per line. The command runs directly, not through a shell — no quotes, variables or pipes here.
schedules.form.command.hint: Runs in your home folder with no AI involved and no tokens in its environment. Saving asks you to approve the command; if the command or a file it runs is changed outside the app, it must be approved again before it runs.
schedules.form.needProgram: Enter the program's absolute path and a 1–60 minute time limit.
schedules.state.unapproved.hint: New command, or the command / a file it runs changed since approval. Open Edit → Save to review and approve it.
schedules.state.proposed.hint: An agent drafted this schedule for you. It does not run yet: open Edit, review it and Save to enable it.
schedules.approve.title: Approve this command?
schedules.approve.body: AWOG will run exactly the command below on schedule, without asking again and with no AI involved. Approve only if you know what every line is. Changing the command or a file it runs requires approving again.
schedules.form.needAccount: Add an account in Settings first.
schedules.toast.skipped: Skipped — the previous run is still going
